## Performance Starts Here: Inside EWP Manufacturing


**August 26, 2026**


[back to posts](https://www.bc.com/blog/)


Whether you’re up at dawn or logging miles driving from jobsite to jobsite, you need products as consistent and dependable as you are. With Boise Cascade Engineered Wood Products, that performance customers know and trust starts at the very beginning – our mills.


Not everyone gets to see the level of detail and care that goes into manufacturing our EWP, but now you can. From using the strength of wood fibers in the most efficient way, to finishing our products with the signature green end seal, the Boise Cascade manufacturing process is designed to deliver EWP with reliable performance.


Only Boise Cascade offers a full range of engineered wood solutions backed by 60+ years of proven performance and customer service. Whether builders are tackling light commercial projects or residential projects, from single homes to large subdivisions, Boise Cascade EWP has the[products](https://www.bc.com/ewp/) ,[software](https://www.bc.com/ewp/software/) , and[support](https://www.bc.com/ewp/support/) to help businesses grow.
